items.title: Claude Fable 5.2 vs Claude Opus 5.5 vs Gemini 4 Carbon vs GPT-6 Astra
items.summary:
Claude Fable 5.2 vs Claude Opus 5.5 vs Gemini 4 Carbon vs GPT-6 Astra 

The first 4-way model comparison result is here. And it's totally insane. 

Same prompt: Dinosaur obstacle run.

Fable 5.2: 9.6/10 - 0h 45m 12s
Opus 5.5: 8.6/10  - 1h 12m 30s
Gemini 4 Carbon: 8.3/10  - 1h 20m 15s
GPT-6 Astra: 7.6/10  - 1h 35m 40s

I know I say it every time, but this is a huge leap. A huge jump. 

Fable takes the crown with an incredible 9.6, finishing significantly faster and dominating the obstacle course like a pro! 

The future looks bright and amazing. 

What do you guys think?

items.title: this is f*cking gold. a four-stroke engine has one job - suck, squeeze, bang, blow. fuel in, fire, piston down, exhaust
items.summary:
this is f*cking gold. a four-stroke engine has one job - suck, squeeze, bang, blow. fuel in, fire, piston down, exhaust out. break the loop and it’s just parts twitching.

four models, same prompt, same engine:
Claude Opus 5.5 · GPT-6 Astra · Gemini 4 Argon · Grok 4.7

three of them run the whole cycle - valves timing, combustion firing, crank turning, oil sitting in the pan. one just gestures at it, half the parts missing.

I didn’t touch a thing and I’m not scoring them. you’ve got eyes: which one’s a real working engine, and which one’s a sketch that forgot how engines work?

Opus, Astra, Gemini or Grok?

items.title: I used Claude Fable 5.1 and GPT-6 Astra to build a self-learning trading algorithm
items.summary:
I used Claude Fable 5.1 and GPT-6 Astra to build a self-learning trading algorithm

The result: +$2,786.41 in 9 days

1,508 launches tracked. 30,160 holders analyzed. 69 wallet clusters detected. Only 6 tokens passed every check, each scoring 85+/100

I MADE THE CORE SCORING CODE OPEN SOURCE (80+ STARS)

GitHub:https://t.co/vaBkwbtFMN

QUANTUMORB IS FULLY OPERATIONAL

- The website, RADAR, SCANNER, Tg bot and entire backend infrastructure are now live
- Hundreds of users are already using QuantumOrb daily

Three recent Solana launches:

Oct 30, 18:08 UTC: $WASTED launched → RADAR alert at 18:49 → 5.1x after the alert

Nov 2, 11:34 UTC: $MAMESUKE launched → RADAR alert at 12:16 → 7.6x after the alert

Nov 3, 21:21 UTC: $AMD launched → RADAR alert at 22:39 → 9.4x after the alert

Here’s how QuantumOrb works:

RADAR tracks new https://t.co/DVKX2i8Gnz launches, bonding curves, market caps and trading activity in real time

SHIELD checks creators before alerts go out. 10+ launches with fewer than 10% graduating? Flagged

SCANNER analyzes the top 20 holders and first 20 buyers, tracking wallet histories, entries and token distribution

CARTOGRAPHER detects connected wallets through shared token sources, same-transaction buys and transfers

GUARD investigates developer history, launch-slot accumulation and remaining dev holdings

ORB combines five risk signals into a 0–100 score and calculates potential selling impact using two models:

Risk Scoring Model

Score = S_operator + S_fresh + S_transfers + S_snipers + S_top20

The system evaluates hidden ownership, fresh wallets, transferred supply, early snipers and holder concentration

Price Impact Model

Impact = 1 − (R / (R + q))²

R = token reserves in the liquidity pool
q = tokens sold by connected wallets

The model estimates how much the price could fall if a linked group exits its positions

RADAR identifies potential runners. SCANNER reveals who’s actually behind them

One system. Real-time alerts. On-chain risk analysis.

QUANTUMORB IS LIVE

And we’re just getting started
